the proposed method has the advantages of high sensitivity and low reagent consumption and can be used for routine determination of total iron in iron and copper ore samples without interference of copper.

the use of potassium dichromate and potassium borohydrides as titrant and reductant, respectively, in the presence of copper ions, is an alternative to ISO standard methods for the determination iron content in iron ore.

the potassium dichromate method with potassium borohydridre reduction can be used as an alternative for the determination of the total iron content in the iron and copper ores.

copper is not a problem in the titration method, it can actually be used to speed up the reaction.
